biocs.name: Rare SMB Session to Remote Host
biocs.description: Detection of an SMB session initiated to a remote host that is not typical for the host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.0/24'
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
